text.COLLECTIBLE_SCHOOLBAG: Can carry 2 active items instead of 1

text.COLLECTIBLE_BOOK_OF_THE_DEAD: Converts killed enemies into temporary orbitals or charmed Bonies

text.COLLECTIBLE_BROKEN_SHOVEL2: Used in the Booster Pack #5 quest

text.COLLECTIBLE_BATTERY_PACK: Recharges active item, spawns 3 random batteries on pickup
text.COLLECTIBLE_THE_SCOOPER: Spawns a temporary familiar similar to The Peeper

text.COLLECTIBLE_ETERNAL_D6: Like a D6, but has a chance to make the item disappear

text.COLLECTIBLE_LOST_SOUL: Familiar, 1 hit per floor, if it survives it grants a random reward

text.COLLECTIBLE_LIL_DUMPY: Familiar, makes stun/poison farts when an enemy or projectile is about to hit the player
text.COLLECTIBLE_BIRDS_EYE: Chance to shoot a big red fire
text.COLLECTIBLE_LODESTONE: Chance to shoot magnetizing tears (attract enemies + tears + projectiles)
text.COLLECTIBLE_ROTTEN_TOMATO: Chance to shoot marked tears (other enemies will attack a marked enemy)
text.COLLECTIBLE_RED_STEW: Full heal, dmg up that wears off over time
text.COLLECTIBLE_GENESIS: Resets player to its initial state and teleport the player to a room where he can pick as many items as they had before
text.COLLECTIBLE_SHARP_KEY: Consumes a key and throws it to deal damage / open doors, +5 keys on pickup. Killed enemies have a chance to spawn rewards from a chest
text.COLLECTIBLE_MEGA_MUSH: Gigantify for a short duration (+damage, +2 range, -tears, invulnerable, crush rocks/blocks/doors)
text.COLLECTIBLE_KNIFE_PIECE_1: Collect the pieces to get a knife familiar
text.COLLECTIBLE_KNIFE_PIECE_2: Collect the pieces to get a knife familiar
text.COLLECTIBLE_DEATH_CERTIFICATE: Allows you to choose one item among all items in the game
text.COLLECTIBLE_BOT_FLY: Familiar, orbits and fires shielded tears
text.COLLECTIBLE_MEAT_CLEAVER: Splits all enemies in the room into 2 smaller versions
text.COLLECTIBLE_EVIL_CHARM: Fear, burn, confusion, toxic gas cloud and Dogma's Godhead tears immunity
text.COLLECTIBLE_DOGMA: Grants fly + a holy mantle. Heal the player to 6 hearts if he has less than 6 hearts
text.COLLECTIBLE_PURGATORY: A red crack spawns at a random position, standing on it will cause a soul to fly to the nearest enemy and hit it
text.COLLECTIBLE_STITCHES: Spawns a temporary familiar, can swap positions with the familiar to deal damage
text.COLLECTIBLE_R_KEY: Restarts the game to the first floor but keeps all items
text.COLLECTIBLE_KNOCKOUT_DROPS: Chance to shoot fist tears (knockback + stun), knocking enemies into walls or other enemies damage them
text.COLLECTIBLE_ERASER: Throw on an enemy to permanently remove that enemy from the current run, recharge every floor
text.COLLECTIBLE_URN_OF_SOULS: A flamethrower weapon that collects one soul per enemy killed
text.COLLECTIBLE_AKELDAMA: Spawns bloody tears behind the player
text.COLLECTIBLE_MAGIC_SKIN: Converts 1 red heart / 2 soul hearts to a broken heart, spawns a pedestal item
text.COLLECTIBLE_REVELATION: Grants flight and an additional angelic beam attack
text.COLLECTIBLE_CONSOLATION_PRIZE: Stat up on the lowest one, +3 coins or +1 bomb or +1 key (depending on lowest)
text.COLLECTIBLE_TINYTOMA: Orbital, splits into blue spiders on hit
text.COLLECTIBLE_BRIMSTONE_BOMBS: +5 bombs, bombs now do a Krampus cross effect on explosion
text.COLLECTIBLE_4_5_VOLT: Active items now only charge based on damage dealt
text.COLLECTIBLE_FRUITY_PLUM: Baby Plum familiar that propel itself diagonally by shooting tears
text.COLLECTIBLE_STAR_OF_BETHLEHEM: A star that moves from starting room to boss room with a Hallowed Ground aura (tears/dmg up + chance to block damage)
text.COLLECTIBLE_CUBE_BABY: A frozen baby familiar that can be kicked
text.COLLECTIBLE_VADE_RETRO: Spawns a little red ghost for each enemy killed and explode when you use the active item again

text.COLLECTIBLE_VASCULITIS: Killed enemies shot blood tears in random directions
text.COLLECTIBLE_GIANT_CELL: Spawn mini Isaacs that follow you and attack enemies when hit
text.COLLECTIBLE_CARD_READING: Spawn 2 of 3 different portals in starting room (red goes to boss room, yellow to treasure room, blue to secret room)
text.COLLECTIBLE_QUINTS: Killed enemies drop a baby familiar that stays in place and shoot in the same direction as the player
text.COLLECTIBLE_TOOTH_AND_NAIL: Transforms the player into a spiked stone statue for 1 sec every 5 sec, invincibility + contact dmg on statue form
text.COLLECTIBLE_BINGE_EATER: For each item you'll see, a food item is proposed. Food items give 2 stat ups and a temporary dmg up
text.COLLECTIBLE_GUPPYS_EYE: Shows the content of chests, fires and shopkeepers
text.COLLECTIBLE_STRAWMAN: A Keeper familiar that acts as a second player and has its own HP and items
text.COLLECTIBLE_DADS_NOTE: Sends you on the backwards path, no gameplay effect
text.COLLECTIBLE_OPTIONS: Can choose between two room reward pickups
text.COLLECTIBLE_CANDY_HEART: Minor random stat up for every red heart picked up
text.COLLECTIBLE_A_POUND_OF_FLESH: Devil deals cost money, shop items cost hearts, shop pickups require to take damage
text.COLLECTIBLE_REDEMPTION: Dmg up + half soul heart at the start of next floor if you took nothing in the devil deal
text.COLLECTIBLE_SPIRIT_SHACKLES: On death, turn into Forgotten's Soul chained to a dead Blue Baby, revives if still alive after 10 sec
text.COLLECTIBLE_CRACKED_ORB: On hit: reveal a random room, open adjacent locked/secret rooms, break tinted rocks or rocks that hides a ladder
text.COLLECTIBLE_EMPTY_HEART: Grants an empty heart container if you enter a new floor with 1 red heart or less
text.COLLECTIBLE_ASTRAL_PROJECTION: On hit: stop time and turn into the lost. Revert into original char on hit or room clear
text.COLLECTIBLE_LIL_ABADDON: Familiar that fires a Maw of the Void ring
text.COLLECTIBLE_MONTEZUMAS_REVENGE: Fires a short diarrhea Brimstone backwards
text.COLLECTIBLE_LIL_PORTAL: A familiar that spawns a portal to an unexplored room if it absorbed enough pickups
text.COLLECTIBLE_WORM_FRIEND: A tentacle that lurks underground and randomly grabs an enemy
text.COLLECTIBLE_HUNGRY_SOUL: Killed enemies have a chance to spawn a homing soul that chases enemies and attack them
text.COLLECTIBLE_JAR_OF_WISPS: Spawns a random wisp + another random wisp for every past uses (up to 12)
text.COLLECTIBLE_SOUL_LOCKET: Minor random stat up for every soul heart picked up
text.COLLECTIBLE_FRIEND_FINDER: Spawns a random controllable friendly enemy
text.COLLECTIBLE_INNER_CHILD: +1 life. On revive, explode and turn into a tiny version of Isaac with higher speed
text.COLLECTIBLE_GLITCHED_CROWN: Pedestals rapidly cycle between 5 random items
text.COLLECTIBLE_BELLY_JELLY: Chance to reflect shots and negate contact damage, bouncing the enemies instead
text.COLLECTIBLE_SACRED_ORB: Prevents quality 0 and 1 items from appearing. 33% chance for quality 2 items to be rerolled
text.COLLECTIBLE_SANGUINE_BOND: Spikes in front of devil statue, taking damage on them can yield various rewards
text.COLLECTIBLE_THE_SWARM: Grants a halo of fly orbitals, turn them into blue flies on hit, +1 orbital fly per room clear
text.COLLECTIBLE_BLOODY_GUST: Tears and speed up on hit (resets every floor)
text.COLLECTIBLE_SALVATION: Grants an aura that makes enemies exploding in a cross of lightbeams after few seconds in it, gets bigger on hit, shrinks upon entering new floor
text.COLLECTIBLE_VANISHING_TWIN: Familiar that turns into a hostile copy of any boss encountered, boss rooms yield double rewards
text.COLLECTIBLE_TWISTED_PAIR: Gives two small demons that copy the player's tears (37.5% of player's dmg for each demon)

text.COLLECTIBLE_ECHO_CHAMBER: Every time a card/pill is used, it also trigger the 3 previous pill/cards used
text.COLLECTIBLE_ISAACS_TOMB: Chest appears in the starting room of each floor, gives at random: 3 soul hearts, 3 trinkets, Old Chest item, Angel item
text.COLLECTIBLE_VENGEFUL_SPIRIT: Spawns an invincible red wisp every time the player takes damage, wisps disappear on next floor
text.COLLECTIBLE_ESAU_JR: Toggle between current char and a mini Esau that starts with high damage and 3 black hearts and has its own items
text.COLLECTIBLE_BERSERK: Temporary +3 dmg and melee attack. This item charge by damaging enemies
text.COLLECTIBLE_DARK_ARTS: Turn into shadow form, phase through enemies to deal damage 2 sec after, more damage dodged = more dmg up
text.COLLECTIBLE_ABYSS: Destroys any item in the room and turn it into permanent red locusts that attack by dashing at enemies
text.COLLECTIBLE_STAPLER: Tears only come out from the player's right eye
text.COLLECTIBLE_SUPLEX: Dash into an enemy, grab it and slam it on the ground. Dmg scales on player's size
text.COLLECTIBLE_BAG_OF_CRAFTING: Take pickups to transform them into items
text.COLLECTIBLE_FLIP: Each pedestal that is part of the room layout will have 2 items. Use Flip to have the second item
text.COLLECTIBLE_LEMEGETON: Spawn an item wisp that grants the effect of a random passive item until it dies
text.COLLECTIBLE_SUMPTORIUM: Spawn a lil clot for half a heart. On T. Eve : convert clots to health
text.COLLECTIBLE_RECALL: Sends back tainted Forgotten's body to the owner
text.COLLECTIBLE_HOLD: Allows you to stock a Tainted Blue Baby poop and throw it later
text.COLLECTIBLE_KEEPERS_SACK: +1 key and +3 coins, gives a dmg/range/speed bonus that scales with the amount of money spent in shops
text.COLLECTIBLE_KEEPERS_KIN: Rocks drop 1-3 spiders when destroyed, rocks can spawn blue spider in room with enemies in it
text.COLLECTIBLE_EVERYTHING_JAR: Can be used anytime, various rewards depending on charge level
text.COLLECTIBLE_TMTRAINER: Causes all future items become glitched, giving fully randomized effects
text.COLLECTIBLE_ANIMA_SOLA: Summons chains around nearest enemy and temporarily prevent it from moving
text.COLLECTIBLE_SPINDOWN_DICE: Rerolls each item in the room into the item before it in numerical ID order
text.COLLECTIBLE_HYPERCOAGULATION: On hit, spawns half a red heart that quickly disappears. Spawned heart's velocity increase the more you take damage
text.COLLECTIBLE_IBS: Causes you to throw a random type of poop at random intervals + chance to have Explosive Diarrhea when standing still
text.COLLECTIBLE_HEMOPTYSIS: Double tap to sneeze on enemies, dealing 1.5x dmg
text.COLLECTIBLE_GHOST_BOMBS: +5 bombs, bombs spawn a friendly white soul which hunt down enemies
text.COLLECTIBLE_GELLO: A baby that come from your belly and deals 3x dmg when it hit enemies, can also shoot tears
text.COLLECTIBLE_DECAP_ATTACK: Throw your head to deal 24 damage
text.COLLECTIBLE_STYE: Damage up/range up/shot speed down on the right eye
